_note: Regenerated 2026-08-06 (/idea-sync, seven-type payments rewrite). Removed: sca-challenge, change-password, forgot-password, transaction-tags (impossible under OBIE FAPI); standing-order-edit (PISP amendment prohibited by OBL CEG); standing-order-create and the send-money / send-money-amount / send-money-confirm / payment-result set (superseded by the per-type payment screens); fx-rates (OBIE exposes no FX rate endpoint, so the screen had no data source at all). Added: the payments hub and seven per-type screens.
_note_2026_08_07: cards and card-detail removed (44 -> 42 screens), decided by the repository owner. OBIE has no card resource: a card is an Account whose Account[].SchemeName == UK.OBIE.PAN, which is why the Card and CardAccountRef DTOs were already deleted on 2026-08-06. The screens were kept then on the argument that filtering the accounts list to PAN entries is a legitimate surface; that argument is overruled — the feature originated in the OBP planning and goes with it. card-detail's central interactions (a freeze/unfreeze toggle, Spending Limits) were impossible against this API and the screen said so itself in its own comment.
